sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', c.date)::date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'HOUSEHOLD_1_005' AND s.state_id = 'WI' GROUP BY ds ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the sum of sales (y) for the specified item and state, aggregated by year (ds), suitable for forecasting the next 5 years.
